_help: 1) Paste your AdSense loader (or other network loader) into head_scripts. 2) Paste each ad unit's HTML into its slot. 3) Set enabled to true and redeploy (copy this file to site/ads.json or run gen.py). Slots with no code collapse when enabled; set show_placeholders false to hide the labelled boxes before codes exist. Every slot is lazy-loaded when it nears the viewport and always shows an 'Advertisement' label. AdSense loader (ca-pub-9817687198003924, Auto ads) is injected into every page <head> by gen.py, so head_scripts stays empty to avoid loading it twice. Paste unit HTML into a slot once data-ad-slot IDs exist.

_slot_map.leaderboard: below the header on every page except /download/
_slot_map.infeed: inside design grids, every 12 cards (home feed, categories, tags, collections, search)
_slot_map.sidebar: sticky right column on desktop >=1180px (listings, search, blog)
_slot_map.anchor: fixed bottom bar on mobile <=720px, closable, shown after first scroll, not on /download/
_slot_map.incontent: design pages, after the About section and above the related grid
_slot_map.countdown_top: /download/ below the title, above the countdown card
_slot_map.countdown_mid: /download/ below the countdown card (separated from the Drive button)
_slot_map.inarticle: blog posts, after paragraph 2 and at the end of the article
